Professional Experience & Qualifications defaults to required; inline preferred, plus, and bonus markers apply only to their respective items.
Although located under Key Responsibilities, the FlowNet-9 bullet explicitly asks for candidate experience, so it is included as unmapped. Other responsibility-only technologies and practices are excluded.
RAG, agentic orchestration, and multi-agent systems remain optional: their required-looking appearances elsewhere describe responsibilities rather than candidate qualifications.
“Or above” does not explicitly name a doctorate; master is the highest degree level named.
